params.name: board
params.description: Board directory short name (e.g. `a`, `b`, `g`, `pol`, `po`, `v`). The full list of valid values is the `board` field on each entry in `/boards.json`.

items.docs: Returns the list of archived (closed, read-only) thread OP numbers for the given board. Archived threads remain viewable until 4chan automatically deletes them. Not every board has archives enabled — boards without an archive return 404.
